usage: World data (option D): real free-agent signings, offer sheets, matches, trades and waivers of the 2003 offseason, dated. Rows with involves_miami are real Miami transactions, skipped by rule 1; they remain as the alternatives Miami competed against. Miami's front office never reads a row before its date.
